purpose: Bounded research on first useful conversations, not equivalence to ChatGPT.
selection: Validation only: weighted prose loss for pretraining; weighted assistant-token loss for tuning.
evaluation: Frozen 24-case portuguese-v1 specification, once after final model selection; include live rollouts for multi-turn cases.

milestone_criterion.review: Semantic review with identified reviewer; no keyword passing. Passing is only a small milestone, not general intelligence.

data_limitations: Source moderation labels are not a full independent factual review.
Historical fiction is not present-day knowledge or behavioral supervision.
Synthetic supplement is separate, limited, and predates this evaluation.
